native_result.query: How does the median wealth of white individuals compare to that of black and Hispanic individuals from 1985 onwards?
native_result.HypoA: 1985 onwards, white individuals have a significantly higher median wealth compared to black and Hispanic individuals.
native_result.HypoB: Median family net wealth of non-Black non-Hispanic ('white'-proxy) NLSY79 respondents exceeded that of Black and Hispanic respondents in every wealth wave from 1985 onward, and the disparity widened sharply: white/Black median ratio rose from 2.2x (1985: $3,500 vs $1,600) to 4.4x (1996: $42,600 vs $9,800), and white/Hispanic from 7.0x ($500) to 16.6x ($2,562); dollar gaps grew ~10-fold to $32,800 (Black) and $40,038 (Hispanic). The widening pattern is robust to a balanced-panel (all three waves) sensitivity and a positives-only median, and is not driven by negative/zero net worth or attrition direction. Caveats: cohort 3 is non-Black non-Hispanic, not strictly white; medians are unweighted sample medians (Black/Hispanic oversamples, no survey weights in file); 1996 missingness is high and differential (52.6% for cohort 3), though the balanced panel supports the conclusion; wealth is family/household-level; extreme wealth is top-coded (affects means, not medians).
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded data/nls_raw.csv (12,686 respondents, 61 vars). Verified racial/ethnic cohort (1=Black n=2002, 2=Hispanic n=3174, 3=non-Black non-Hispanic n=7510) and Sample ID codes mapping perfectly to cohorts (cross-sectional + poor-white oversample + military within cohort 3; Hispanic and Black oversamples otherwise). Primary analysis: unweighted available-case medians of Family net wealth for 1985/1990/1996 by cohort, with dollar gaps and white-referenced ratios; negatives/zeros kept. Sensitivities: balanced panel (n=5,739 observed in all waves) and positives-only medians. Supporting: asset-component medians among owners; attrition diagnostics (per-wave missingness, stayer/dropout 1985 medians); top-code checks. Outputs: analysis_nls_wealth.py, results_log.txt, nls_wealth_results.xlsx (5 sheets).
